pages.title: Meteoric Iron
pages.text: Iron and nickel from the core of a planetesimal that shattered billions of years ago. Etched, it shows crossed plates that grew only a degree in a million years.

Made in $(item)Spectrograph$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Iron Meteorite$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Exoplanetology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Iron-Nickel, Peridot.
